title: Legacy Block 5 Light: Supreme Chancellor Palpatine

cards.title: Supreme Chancellor Palpatine
issues: Card code matches print. CI fails on SupremeChancellorPalpatineCanMakeTwoRegularMovesAwayFromCoruscantButNotThree: shared engine bookkeeping counts the first ordinary move against the MayMakeAdditionalMovesModifier grant (getGrantedAdditionalMovesUsedThisTurn), so the additional regular move is not available.

review.blocked_on: Engine fix for granted additional-move bookkeeping (MayMakeAdditionalMovesModifier / ModifiersQuerying granted-move counting), requested in swccg-guild/work#182 comment 6700477278. No PR for it is in the review set.
review.notes: Merge after the engine fix lands and this test goes green; no card changes expected.

pc_front.gametext: Agendas: ambition, order. While on Coruscant, Ambush is a Used Interrupt and, each time you initiate a Force drain with a clone, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. During your turn, may make an additional regular move. Valorum is lost.
